rules: Animate transform and opacity only for smooth hardware acceleration
Active button clicks must provide instantaneous 80ms scale(0.98) tactile feedback
Diagnostic selector state transitions must re-render in place without layout jitter
All animations must gracefully degrade to instant opacity fades under prefers-reduced-motion

doNotAnimate.target: Body text and technical specification paragraphs
doNotAnimate.because: Must remain perfectly stationary for rapid trade scanning on jobsite screens

doNotAnimate.target: Hotline telephone triggers and direct call buttons
doNotAnimate.because: Contractors with urgent breakdown needs must experience zero click latency or tap drift

doNotAnimate.target: Map location coordinates and operating hours table
doNotAnimate.because: Critical physical dispatch information must remain fixed and readable

signatureAnimation: Dynamic fault matrix where selecting tool category and symptom triggers an instant spring-driven counter re-evaluation, animated bench checklist assembly, and prefilled email modal.
